payload.reason: The evidence provides specific correlations between different variants of ROUGE scores and their effectiveness in summarization evaluation, particularly in relation to human judgments.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE scores yield varying correlation values with human judgments, indicating that not all ROUGE scores are equally effective.
ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 show better correlations with manual judgments in scientific summarization compared to ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L, which have weak correlations.
The highest overall correlation with pyramid scores is obtained by ROUGE-3, while ROUGE-L and ROUGE-W show weak correlations.
Keyword-based reduction variants of the proposed metric Sera show high correlations with manual evaluation, unlike many ROUGE variants.
